questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A ball is thrown vertically upward with a velocity of 20 m/s. The maximum height reached is: (g = 10 m/s²)
questions.explanation: At maximum height, v = 0. Using v² = u² - 2gh: 0 = 20² - 2(10)h. h = 400/20 = 20 m.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two particles of mass m and 2m have equal kinetic energies. The ratio of their linear momenta is:
questions.explanation: KE = p²/2m. For equal KE: p₁²/(2m) = p₂²/(2×2m). p₁²/m = p₂²/(2m). p₁²/p₂² = m/(2m) = 1/2. p₁/p₂ = 1/√2 = 1:√2.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A charge q is placed at the center of a cube. The electric flux through one face is:
questions.explanation: Total flux through cube by Gauss's law = q/ε₀. By symmetry, flux through each of 6 faces is equal = (q/ε₀)/6 = q/6ε₀.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A concave mirror of focal length f produces an image n times the size of the object. If the image is real, the distance of the object from the mirror is:
questions.explanation: m = -v/u = -n (real image, inverted). v = nu. Using 1/f = 1/v + 1/u = 1/(nu) + 1/u = (1+n)/(nu). u = (n+1)f/n.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of neutrons in ¹⁹F ion is:
questions.explanation: ¹⁹F has mass number 19 and atomic number 9. Neutrons = Mass number - Atomic number = 19 - 9 = 10. Charge doesn't affect neutron count.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The shape of XeF₄ molecule is:
questions.explanation: Xe has 8 valence electrons. 4 bond pairs with F, 2 lone pairs. Total 6 electron pairs = octahedral electron geometry. Molecular shape (considering only atoms) = square planar.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: According to Le Chatelier's principle, adding pressure to the equilibrium system N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) will:
questions.explanation: Reactants: 4 moles gas. Products: 2 moles gas. Increasing pressure favours the side with fewer moles, i.e., forward reaction (NH₃ formation).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Carbylamine test is used to detect:
questions.explanation: Carbylamine test (isocyanide test) involves heating primary amine with CHCl₃ and alcoholic KOH to produce foul-smelling isocyanide. Only primary amines give this test.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The value of ⁵C₀ + ⁵C₁ + ⁵C₂ + ⁵C₃ + ⁵C₄ + ⁵C₅ is:
questions.explanation: Sum of binomial coefficients = ⁿC₀ + ⁿC₁ + ... + ⁿCₙ = 2ⁿ. For n=5: 2⁵ = 32.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The equation of the line passing through (1, 2) and parallel to the line 2x + 3y = 7 is:
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have same slope. Given line: 3y = -2x + 7, slope = -2/3. Equation through (1,2): y - 2 = (-2/3)(x - 1). 3y - 6 = -2x + 2. 2x + 3y = 8.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The value of lim(x→0) (eˣ - 1)/x is:
questions.explanation: This is a standard limit: lim(x→0) (eˣ - 1)/x = 1. Can also use L'Hospital's rule: lim(x→0) eˣ/1 = 1.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) is synthesized in:
questions.explanation: The nucleolus is the site of rRNA transcription and ribosomal subunit assembly.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following is a micronutrient for plants?
questions.explanation: Micronutrients are required in small amounts: Fe, Mn, Cu, Zn, B, Mo, Cl. Macronutrients (required in large amounts): N, P, K, Ca, Mg, S.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The site of light reaction in photosynthesis is:
questions.explanation: Light reactions (photophosphorylation) occur on the thylakoid membranes. Dark reactions (Calvin cycle) occur in the stroma.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The theory of 'Survival of the fittest' was proposed by:
questions.explanation: Charles Darwin proposed the theory of natural selection, which includes the concept of 'survival of the fittest' (term coined by Herbert Spencer but associated with Darwinism).
